title: Women's Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Tee

seo.title: French Bulldog Shirt – Silent Night, Except the Snoring
seo.description: A funny French Bulldog shirt for Christmas: a snoring fawn Frenchie in a Santa hat under SILENT NIGHT. EXCEPT THE SNORING. Relaxed women's tee, S–3XL.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

Silent night, except the snoring: a French Bulldog shirt for the Frenchie mom whose dog sleeps through Christmas morning louder than the carols. Wear it to the tree, the cookie swap or the long lazy hour after the wrapping paper, and let the dog prove the joke.

The art is a 1950s Christmas-card scene: a fawn French Bulldog with a dark mask and big upright bat ears, in a slightly crooked red Santa hat, lies belly-down on a plaid tree skirt between two wrapped presents, eyes shut and mouth open mid-snore, a few z's rising above its head, with pine needles and one fallen red ornament nearby. SILENT NIGHT. runs across the top in heavy deep-red capitals and EXCEPT THE SNORING. across the bottom in pine green; on the dark shirts they turn cream and mustard, and the scene gets a cream outline.

It makes an easy gift for the Frenchie owner who has already been woken by the real thing, from a partner, a sister or the dog walker. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Relaxed fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: White, Natural, Pink, Heather Stone, Black, Navy, Maroon, Forest Green
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras, or the US

Questions

How does the Silent Night, Except the Snoring tee fit?
The Silent Night, Except the Snoring tee from Graphic Tees Co. is a Bella+Canvas 6400 relaxed women's cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy fit or go up one for an oversized, cozy look. Compare the size chart with a tee you already own, and the first exchange is free.

What is it made of and how do I wash it?
It is 100% combed, ring-spun cotton at a lightweight 4.2 oz/yd², pre-shrunk with side seams; the heather colors contain polyester. Turn the Graphic Tees Co. tee inside out, wash it cold with similar colors and tumble dry low. Skip bleach so the red, green and mustard inks stay bright.

What colors does it come in and how is it printed?
It comes in White, Natural, Pink and Heather Stone with a deep red headline and pine green punch line, and in Black, Navy, Maroon and Forest Green with a cream headline, mustard punch line and a cream outline around the dog. Graphic Tees Co. prints each tee to order in sizes S through 3XL.

Who is it a good gift for?
It is a good gift for a Frenchie mom, a partner who knows the snoring is the real soundtrack of the house, or a sister whose dog hogs the couch. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order, orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess.

When should I order it for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 so the Silent Night, Except the Snoring tee from Graphic Tees Co. arrives before Christmas. Each shirt is printed to order, which takes a few business days, then ships within the US. A misprint or damaged shirt is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.
